title: Jim Semivan's bedroom encounter with beings and a guardian

tellings.quote: "I was standing there with my wife and these beings were there and there was somebody behind me.

plain: A man named Jim Semivan says he once stood in his home with his wife while strange beings were there, and someone stood behind him like a guardian: "I was standing there with my wife and these beings were there and there was somebody behind me." The researcher Grant Cameron repeats this as what Semivan described, also naming a person called Ian Dolly. If true, it would be a direct encounter with nonhuman beings in an ordinary bedroom.
